facts.label: disputed
facts.quote: Intricate rock carvings show Abhimanyu entering the Chakra vyuha... carved on stone in the Hoysaleshwara temple in Halebidu, Karnataka.
facts.text: Viral claims assert that a 5,000-year-old stone map of the Chakravyuha exists in Kurukshetra, but archaeologists identify images circulating in public media as either medieval temple friezes from the 12th-century CE Hoysaleswara Temple at Halebidu or modern architectural park designs.

facts.label: legend
facts.quote: Where even today children play this game of creation and piercing of the Chakravyuh in the streets. It is said that the people here have got this art naturally
facts.text: Folklore in Haryana maintains that village children around Abhimanyupur instinctively know the layout of drawing the 7 concentric spiral paths of the Chakravyuha.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: Abhimanyu, Arjuna's son, was killed on the 13th day in the Chakravyuha.
facts.text: In the Drona Parva of the Mahabharata, Dronacharya forms the Kaurava army into the circular battle array known as the Padma or Chakravyuha on the 13th day of the Kurukshetra war to capture Yudhishthira.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: knowledge of how to penetrate it was limited to only a handful of warriors on the Pandavas' side, namely: Abhimanyu, Arjuna, Krishna and Pradyumna, of whom only Abhimanyu was present when the Kauravas used it on the battlefield.
facts.text: The Drona Parva specifies that only 4 warriors on the Pandava side—Arjuna, Krishna, Pradyumna, and Abhimanyu—knew how to penetrate the rotating formation, though Abhimanyu alone lacked the technique to exit it.

facts.label: disputed
facts.quote: Since the first excavations at Indraprashta in early 1950s, there have been at least six excavations at places mentioned in the Mahabharata, but the ASI hasn't unearthed any conclusive or direct evidence to establish historical facts.
facts.text: While proponents of epic historicity propose that Painted Grey Ware layers dating around 900 BCE correspond to the Mahabharata conflict, critical archaeologists state that material evidence shows domestic settlement continuity without proof of the specific epic battles or named warriors.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: Jayadratha closed the gap behind him and kept the rest of the pandava supporting force from entering.
facts.text: The text of the Drona Parva records that Jayadratha checked the Pandava reinforcements at the breach, cutting off Abhimanyu from support and leaving him surrounded within the formation.
